title: Add context fields to BulletModel for CGR³ support
description:
Extend BulletModel in src/storage/models.py with context graph fields:

Temporal validity:
- valid_from: datetime (when pattern became valid)
- valid_until: datetime | None (expiration, null = still valid)
- temporal_confidence: float (decays over time)
- tech_context: JSON (e.g., {"python": ">=3.10", "tensorflow": "2.x"})

Locality context:
- team_id: str | None
- project_ids: JSON list
- applicable_domains: JSON list

Enhanced provenance:
- created_by_type: str (human | ai | derived)
- source_conversation_id: str | None
- confidence_score: float

Also add BulletLineageModel for knowledge relationships (derived_from, refined, contradicts, supersedes).

title: Implement 'ace learn' CLI command for manual knowledge entry
description:
Add a 'learn' subcommand to ace_cli.py that allows manually adding knowledge to playbooks. Should support:
- Content as positional argument
- --type flag (decision, pattern, snippet, troubleshooting, domain)
- --tags flag for comma-separated tags
- --playbook flag to target specific playbook
- Mark human-authored bullets with created_by_model='human'

title: Add interactive mode for 'ace learn'
description:
Add --interactive flag to 'ace learn' for guided knowledge entry:
- Prompt for knowledge type
- Multi-line content entry
- Tag suggestions based on existing tags
- Confirmation before saving
- Example: ace learn --interactive

title: Add batch import from markdown for 'ace learn'
description:
Extend 'ace learn' command with --file flag to import knowledge from markdown files:
- Parse markdown, extract sections (## headings become separate bullets)
- Support frontmatter for tags/metadata
- Handle ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md style documents
- Example: ace learn --file decisions.md --type decision

title: Implement CGR³ (Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason) service layer
description:
Create a standalone knowledge retrieval service that any code generation consumer can call:
- Retrieve: Semantic search (existing)
- Rank: Re-rank by context match (team, project, tech stack, temporal validity)
- Reason: Determine verdict (APPLY, ASK_FIRST, SKIP) based on context sufficiency

Key components:
- RetrievalContext dataclass (team_id, project_id, tech_stack, query_timestamp)
- RankedBullet with semantic_score, context_score, context_gaps, verdict
- ContextGraphRetriever class wrapping BulletRetriever
- Scoring functions for temporal, team, tech stack, project context

This is an Enterprise-only feature that adds reasoning on top of existing audit infrastructure.
